about_the_game:
“Resources Assemble!” is a working title and may change before release.

The game is in early development — visuals and interface are subject to change

TL;DR: Factorio-like production depth merging idle progression.

Resources Assemble!

Take charge of a massive industrial empire!

Build, optimize, and expand complex production chains — from simple mining operations to high-tech facilities capable of launching rockets into space.

Research new technologies, unlock automation, and watch your factory run even while you’re away.

Manage Production

Begin with the most basic resources and gradually develop an efficient industrial ecosystem.

Every stage can be upgraded, automated, and scaled without limits.

  • Extract resources — mine iron, copper, coal, and more.

  • Process materials — refine raw ores into components and parts.

  • Build machines — automate production and resource handling.

  • Expand — add new lines, improve logistics, and boost efficiency.

Research Technologies

Unlock new machines and recipes that push your factory to the next level.

The tech tree lets you progress from manual control to full automation — from simple mechanics to advanced high-tech systems.

From Ground to Space

Your ultimate goal — build a system capable of constructing and launching a rocket beyond the planet.

The path there is an endless cycle of improvement, optimization, and discovery.

Each stage brings new challenges and opportunities for growth.

Key Features:

  • Resource extraction, refining, and automation

  • Deep logistics and storage systems

  • Balance between energy, speed, and productivity

  • Research and tech progression

  • Idle mechanics — your factory keeps running offline

  • Endless room for optimization

Planned Features:

  • Game Data Editor — create your own resources, machines, and recipes, and experiment with custom balance setups

  • New resource and machine types — an expanded tech tree and more complex production chains

  • Transportation systems — logistics between factories and even between planets

  • Defensive technologies — prepare for unexpected threats emerging as your factory grows

  • Space stage — expand production beyond your home planet

  • Import support from compatible sources — load data for items, recipes, and technologies from mods or saves of other factory games, including *Factorio*-compatible formats

Resources Assemble! — a game for those who find joy in turning chaos into order. Become the architect of the perfect automated machine!
